_source: GAA Organisational Charts, May 2026, slide 11 (Business Development & Corporate Communications). Establishment snapshot: post counts in _deck_posts are as at 2026-05-06 and are NOT loaded into the database.
_grades: Grade bands in seniority order. establishment_band maps the department's local band onto the GAA-wide establishment ladder. _deck_posts records the budgeted posts shown on the chart; the Grade table has no post-count column, so the seeder ignores it.
_people: No people: the source chart is anonymised. Employment records are seeded separately.
